html:
The Birria are an Aboriginal Australian people of southwest Queensland. On the map their lands lie around the meeting of the Thomson and Barcoo rivers, which join to form Cooper Creek, near today's Windorah.

Very little is written about them. Their neighbours were the Karuwali to the west, the Wangkumara to the south and the Kuungkari to the north. Cattle stations took this channel country in the 1870s.
